ClassroomSession.title: ClassroomSession
ClassroomSession.description: Real-time online whiteboard classroom session managed by a teacher and joined by students.

teacherUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher who created the classroom.

allowStudentDrawing.description: Whether students are allowed to draw on the shared whiteboard globally.

currentPageIndex.description: Zero-based index of the currently active whiteboard page.

participantCount.description: Number of active participants in the classroom.

pagesJson.description: Serialized multi-page whiteboard strokes, shapes, and math objects.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last stroke or state sync (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ClassroomMember.title: ClassroomMember
ClassroomMember.description: A participant (teacher or student) inside an active classroom session.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the participant.

roomCode.description: Parent classroom code for scoped queries.

canDraw.description: Individual drawing permission controlled by the teacher.

joinedAt.description: Server timestamp when the participant joined.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when permission or status was last updated.

/classrooms/{roomCode}.description: Root collection of real-time online whiteboard classrooms.

/classrooms/{roomCode}/members/{memberUi.description: Subcollection of classroom participants and per-student drawing permissions.
